jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
The Role  We're looking for a  Senior DevOps Engineer  with strong expertise in  Microsoft Azure  to take the lead in designing, optimizing, securing, and ensuring the reliability of our cloud infrastructure. In this role, you'll be responsible for the management and optimization of our CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure automation, security posture, performance monitoring, and cost efficiency across Azure. You'll take operational ownership, including responding to Azure alerts, proactively improving performance, and maintaining a robust security framework for our Azure environment.  This is a  full-time, remote position  based in the  Philippines .  Key Responsibilities   Automation & CI/CD   
  Automate the build, test, deployment, and infrastructure provisioning pipelines using  Azure DevOps ,  Bicep/ARM , or  Terraform .  
  Design, maintain, and optimize secure, scalable  CI/CD pipelines  integrated with  GitHub  or  Azure Repos .  
  Enhance deployment reliability and speed by applying  automation best practices .  
   Azure Infrastructure Management   
  Design, maintain, and optimize secure, scalable  Azure infrastructure  (e.g.,  App Services ,  AKS ,  Azure Functions ,  Key Vault ,  Azure Monitor ).  
  Manage networking, identity, and access controls using  Azure best practices  (Azure AD, RBAC, NSGs, VNets).  
  Own the performance and health of  Azure resources  across various environments (dev, staging, production).  
  Continuously improve cost efficiency and performance using  Azure Cost Management ,  Azure Advisor , and  right-sizing strategies .  
   Monitoring, Alerts & Reliability   
  Implement end-to-end  monitoring ,  logging , and  alerting  using  Azure Monitor ,  Application Insights , and  Log Analytics .  
  Actively monitor and respond to  Azure alerts , incidents, and performance issues.  
  Proactively manage server and application performance (CPU, memory, scaling, latency, throughput).  
  Ensure  high availability , backup, and  disaster recovery  strategies are in place and regularly tested.  
  Lead  root cause analysis  and drive improvements to prevent recurring issues.  
   Security & Compliance   
  Continuously improve  Azure Secure Score  and implement security best practices across environments.  
  Address  Microsoft Defender for Cloud  recommendations to strengthen security posture.  
  Enforce security practices (e.g.,  least privilege ,  secret management , patching, vulnerability remediation).  
  Collaborate with engineering to ensure  secure cloud-native architecture patterns .  
   Quality & Collaboration   
  Work closely with engineering and QA teams to support release automation and ensure environment stability.  
  Participate in  system architecture  discussions and performance tuning of infrastructure.  
  Document  infrastructure standards , runbooks, and operational procedures to ensure consistency.  
  What Were Looking For   Must-Have Technical Skills   
   7+ years of DevOps/SRE experience , with at least  3+ years focused on Microsoft Azure .  
  Strong experience with  Infrastructure as Code  tools (e.g.,  Terraform ,  Bicep ,  ARM templates ).  
  Hands-on experience managing  production Azure environments .  
  Proficient in  scripting languages  like  PowerShell ,  Python , or  Bash .  
  Experience with  containerization  and  orchestration  (e.g.,  Docker ,  Kubernetes ,  AKS ).  
  Experience with  CI/CD tools  like  Azure DevOps Pipelines  or  GitHub Actions .  
  Deep knowledge of  Azure monitoring ,  alerting ,  cost optimization , and  security services .  
  Solid understanding of  Linux systems ,  networking , and  cloud security best practices .

  Strong understanding of  SaaS uptime ,  reliability , and  scalability  needs.

This role includes work on data-intensive risk and compliance analytics products: applications that ingest security and inventory data from multiple, heterogeneous, and sometimes inconsistent sources, normalize it into a consistent internal model, and present risk, gap, and prioritization analytics to different classes of users (executive, program-management, and technical).  Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack application capabilities with an emphasis on secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready software.

new_jobs.description:
The Role  We're looking for a  Senior DevOps Engineer  with strong expertise in  Microsoft Azure  to take the lead in designing, optimizing, securing, and ensuring the reliability of our cloud infrastructure. In this role, you'll be responsible for the management and optimization of our CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure automation, security posture, performance monitoring, and cost efficiency across Azure. You'll take operational ownership, including responding to Azure alerts, proactively improving performance, and maintaining a robust security framework for our Azure environment.  This is a  full-time, remote position  based in the  Philippines .  Key Responsibilities   Automation & CI/CD   
  Automate the build, test, deployment, and infrastructure provisioning pipelines using  Azure DevOps ,  Bicep/ARM , or  Terraform .  
  Design, maintain, and optimize secure, scalable  CI/CD pipelines  integrated with  GitHub  or  Azure Repos .  
  Enhance deployment reliability and speed by applying  automation best practices .  
   Azure Infrastructure Management   
  Design, maintain, and optimize secure, scalable  Azure infrastructure  (e.g.,  App Services ,  AKS ,  Azure Functions ,  Key Vault ,  Azure Monitor ).  
  Manage networking, identity, and access controls using  Azure best practices  (Azure AD, RBAC, NSGs, VNets).  
  Own the performance and health of  Azure resources  across various environments (dev, staging, production).  
  Continuously improve cost efficiency and performance using  Azure Cost Management ,  Azure Advisor , and  right-sizing strategies .  
   Monitoring, Alerts & Reliability   
  Implement end-to-end  monitoring ,  logging , and  alerting  using  Azure Monitor ,  Application Insights , and  Log Analytics .  
  Actively monitor and respond to  Azure alerts , incidents, and performance issues.  
  Proactively manage server and application performance (CPU, memory, scaling, latency, throughput).  
  Ensure  high availability , backup, and  disaster recovery  strategies are in place and regularly tested.  
  Lead  root cause analysis  and drive improvements to prevent recurring issues.  
   Security & Compliance   
  Continuously improve  Azure Secure Score  and implement security best practices across environments.  
  Address  Microsoft Defender for Cloud  recommendations to strengthen security posture.  
  Enforce security practices (e.g.,  least privilege ,  secret management , patching, vulnerability remediation).  
  Collaborate with engineering to ensure  secure cloud-native architecture patterns .  
   Quality & Collaboration   
  Work closely with engineering and QA teams to support release automation and ensure environment stability.  
  Participate in  system architecture  discussions and performance tuning of infrastructure.  
  Document  infrastructure standards , runbooks, and operational procedures to ensure consistency.  
  What Were Looking For   Must-Have Technical Skills   
   7+ years of DevOps/SRE experience , with at least  3+ years focused on Microsoft Azure .  
  Strong experience with  Infrastructure as Code  tools (e.g.,  Terraform ,  Bicep ,  ARM templates ).  
  Hands-on experience managing  production Azure environments .  
  Proficient in  scripting languages  like  PowerShell ,  Python , or  Bash .  
  Experience with  containerization  and  orchestration  (e.g.,  Docker ,  Kubernetes ,  AKS ).  
  Experience with  CI/CD tools  like  Azure DevOps Pipelines  or  GitHub Actions .  
  Deep knowledge of  Azure monitoring ,  alerting ,  cost optimization , and  security services .  
  Solid understanding of  Linux systems ,  networking , and  cloud security best practices .  
   DevOps & SaaS Mindset   
  Strong understanding of  SaaS uptime ,  reliability , and  scalability  needs.  
  Experience managing production systems with  incident response  ownership.  
  Proactive approach to  automation ,  observability ,  cost control , and  security  improvemen

This is a hands-on development role  The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with experience developing applications in FISMA/FedRAMP environments and familiarity with NIST security and compliance frameworks. They are comfortable owning software across the full development lifecycle—from design and development through CI/CD, deployment, and production operations—and can effectively work across software development, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and compliance.  This role includes work on data-intensive risk and compliance analytics products: applications that ingest security and inventory data from multiple, heterogeneous, and sometimes inconsistent sources, normalize it into a consistent internal model, and present risk, gap, and prioritization analytics to different classes of users (executive, program-management, and technical).  Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack application capabilities with an emphasis on secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready software. 
 Develop backend services, APIs, integrations, automation, and supporting tools.

 Design and implement integrations with cloud services, security technologies, vulnerability management platforms, monitoring solutions, and third-party systems using REST APIs and structured. 
 Develop capabilities that ingest, process, correlate, and present security and compliance information while automating workflows such as security monitoring, vulnerability management, evidence collection, control management, and reporting. 
 Design data models and normalization/correlation logic capable of reconciling overlapping or conflicting records from multiple independent data sources into a single, consistent, and traceable representation, preserving source provenance and confidence. 
 Design and implement configurable scoring, prioritization, or risk-analytics logic as discrete, testable components rather than embedded business rules — supporting features such as gap analysis, trend analysis, and what-if/scenario comparison. 
 Model relationships and dependencies between assets, systems, and organizational entities in a way that supports drill-down analysis and can scale toward graph-based or dependency-graph representations as products mature. 
 Implement role-based access control and role-differentiated views so that different user types (executive, program/system management, technical) see appropriately scoped and appropriately detailed information. 
 Develop, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes that support application builds, automated testing, security validation, and reliable deployment across development, staging, and production environments. 
 Build, deploy, and support containerized and cloud-native applications, collaborating with cloud and DevOps engineers to improve application scalability, reliability, observability, security, and performance. 
 Use AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar technologies as part of day-to-day engineering workflows to accelerate coding, debugging, refactoring, testing, documentation, and code analysis. 
 Apply engineering judgment when working with AI-generated code and recommendations, validating outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, performance, and alignment with engineering standards.
